title: Tagine of Fish with Algerian Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African dish made with fish, algerian spices, and a hint of peppery heat.

ingredients.name: Algerian spices (including cumin, coriander, and cinnamon)

instructions: Rinse the fish and pat it dry with paper towels.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the Algerian spices and peppercorns and stir for 1-2 minutes.
Add the fish and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until it's cooked through.
Add the aerated water to the pan and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
Serve hot over rice or couscous.
